description.zh: 呼叫权限，0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
description.en: The call permission. Valid values: `0` (unrestricted), `1` (domestic long-distance), `2` (local), and `3` (internal calls). The default value is `0`.
The ID of the call center.

description.zh: 呼入是否录音，0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Indicates whether to record inbound calls. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 是否被座席绑定，1 绑定 0未绑定
description.en: Indicates whether the extension is bound to an agent. Valid values: `1` (bound) and `0` (unbound). The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 是否允许外呼，0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
description.en: Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. Valid values: `1` (allowed) and `0` (disallowed). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 条数；正整数 大于0 小于等于500 默认为10条
description.en: The number of extensions to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 500. The default value is 10.

description.zh: 外呼是否录音，0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
description.en: Indicates whether to record outbound calls. Valid values: `1` (enabled) and `0` (disabled). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 从第几条开始；正整数 默认为0
description.en: The number of entries to skip for pagination. The default value is 0.

description.zh: 类型，1. 注册到IAD分机 2.注册到webrtc 3.注册到远程话机
description.en: The registration type. Valid values: `1` (IAD extension), `2` (WebRTC), and `3` (remote phone).
